problem: The final website pass still allowed uneven pricing CTA geometry, variable header height, empty section whitespace and portal visual models that could feel oversized or escape their cards at narrower widths. Post-merge browser readback also exposed a hydrated mobile topbar regression at 287.34px and a preview assertion still pinned to superseded proposition copy. Exact production readback on a 390x844 viewport still measured the hydrated topbar at 287.34px.
root_cause: Functional and content parity were already covered, but the final responsive geometry contract was only partially encoded in CSS and regression tests. A later-loaded <=430px portal-polish rule overrode the compact two-column action row, while the preview workflow still grepped legacy copy. Even after preserving the action-row columns, the mobile shell retained two 44px utility rows plus welcome subtitle and generous vertical spacing.
decision: Lock card/CTA geometry, public header height, empty-shell suppression and portal visual containment at desktop, tablet and mobile breakpoints. Preserve the compact action row after hydration and keep preview assertions aligned to the canonical Powerhouse wording. Make the <=430px shell explicitly compact while preserving all interactive controls.
prevention: Pricing CTAs use a fixed row height and flex cards keep their CTA at the bottom.
The canonical public header has explicit desktop/tablet/mobile minimum heights.
Genuinely empty section shells do not reserve vertical space.
Portal model visuals are width-contained and progressively capped at 1180, 900 and 640 pixel breakpoints.
Responsive geometry is guarded by the website coherence regression test.
At <=430px the hydrated action row remains minmax(0,1fr) + auto instead of stacking every action vertically.
Portal live-preview assertions check the canonical 'Zo werkt Powerhouse in je bedrijf' wording rather than superseded copy.
Source-level proposition tests inspect the rendered product-truth constant, not legacy-cleanup regex literals.

Replay assertions must match the actual finalizer implementation shape: productTruth is a template literal and product insertion is anchored to mainStart/firstSection rather than obsolete pr-hero variables.
At <=430px hide the non-essential welcome subtitle, reduce the title to 24px, shrink utility controls to the contract-safe 40px minimum and reduce topbar gaps/padding.
Keep the Playwright production contract at <260px so future hydration or cascade changes fail closed.
Portal browser parity assertions must use the same canonical heading as the hydrated portal: 'Zo werkt Powerhouse in je bedrijf'.
